% A report with minitoc's shortext option, which names its numbered files
% with one letter: M, F, and T for the mini tables of a chapter, and P, G,
% and U for those of a part. Beside them are the files of an earlier
% build that loaded xcolor, in minitoc's own format: each entry has
% \textcolor, and xcolor is not loaded here. Under tex4ht, \parttoc,
% \partlof, and \partlot read the files of index 0, so the stale .P1, .G1,
% and .U1 are guards. The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage[shortext]{minitoc}
\begin{document}
\dominitoc
\dominilof
\dominilot
\doparttoc
\dopartlof
\dopartlot
\tableofcontents
\listoffigures
\listoftables
\part{First part}
\parttoc
\partlof
\partlot
\chapter{First}
\minitoc
\minilof
\minilot
Text of the first chapter.
\section{New section}
Text of the section.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\end{document}
